params.name: app_unique_id
params.description:
Pass the app unique ID to retrieve the instances of the app. You can retrieve the unique ID of an app using the **Get Apps** endpoint. 
If the app ID is not passed, all available instances will be retrieved.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of available instances for all apps. To retrieve instances of a specific app, pass the unique ID of the app.

params.name: app_slug
params.description:
Pass the app's unique resource identifier to generate a downloadable response file.
Example: *abuse_ipdb_1_1_0*.
You can retrieve the app slug of an app using the **Get Apps** endpoint.

items.docs: Download the app's ZIP file by entering the app identifier. You can save the response as a ZIP file to your device.

params.name: action_id
params.description:
Pass the unique ID of the action to retrieve the action details. 
Example: *52091b28-5daa-42f3-9eb9-926994a91ca5*.
You can retrieve unique ID of an action using the **Get App Actions** endpoint.

items.docs: Returns the details of a specific action.

params.name: app_unique_id
params.description: Pass the unique ID of the app to retrieve the list of actions. Example: *f8f6af0e-35c8-48e3-8cda-d0fe61476441*. You can retrieve the unique ID of an app using the **Get Apps** endpoint.

params.name: page
params.description: Pass the page number to retrieve the app actions list.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Pass the number of items to view per page.

params.name: app_unique_id
params.description:
Enter the unique ID of the app to retrieve its details.
You can retrieve the unique IDs of apps using the **Get Apps** endpoint.

items.docs: Returns the details of a specific app.

params.name: instance_id
params.description:
Pass the unique ID of the instance to retrieve details of the app instance. 
Example: *d6a03423-52fd-479b-a79d-85102e53861*.
You can retrieve the instance ID using the **Get App Instances** endpoint.

items.docs: Returns the details of a specific instance.

params.name: q
params.description: Pass a value for q to search for apps matching the query string.

params.name: ordering
params.description: Use `ordering=title` to sort by title or `ordering=modified_at` to sort by the last update date. Add `-` before the parameter to sort in descending order.

params.name: page
params.description: Pass the page number to retrieve the apps list.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Pass the number of items to retrieve per page.

params.name: created_by
params.description: Pass the user ID to retrieve a list of the apps created by a user.

params.name: app_type
params.description: Pass `READY_TO_USE` to list active apps, `IN_PROGRESS` to list the inactive apps, and `INSTALLED` to retrieve apps that are installed.

params.name: categories
params.description: Pass the categories to filter apps.

params.name: is_system
params.description: Pass false to retrieve custom apps or true to retrieve apps.

params.name: is_configured
params.description: Pass true to get configured apps or false to get non-configured apps.

params.name: lite_enabled
params.description: Pass true to retrieve agent-compatible apps or false to fetch apps that are not agent-compatible.

params.name: created_at
params.description: Pass the `created_at` value to filter apps created in the last week, month, or year.

params.name: created_at__gte
params.description: Pass the start time in Unix time format. The list of apps created after the entered time will be returned. Example: *1655145000*.

params.name: created_at__lte
params.description: Pass the end time in Unix time format. The list of apps created before the entered time will be returned. Example: *1642530599*.

params.name: instance_id
params.description:
Enter the unique ID of the instance to test the connectivity. 
Example: *d6a03423-52fd-479b-a79d-85102e53861f*.
You can retrieve the instance ID using the **Get App Instances** endpoint.
